title: Late Afternoon — EN/ES/IT (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 98bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate Spanish Italian language learning garden golden hour Perth Zimbabwe
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Late afternoon in the Perth summer and the light has changed its angle
The shadows are longer and the garden's in a different tangle
Of colour and of texture and the temperature has slipped
Late afternoon is when the whole day has been sipped

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El final de la tarde en el verano de Perth y la luz cambia de ángulo
[Late afternoon in the Perth summer and the light changes its angle]
Las sombras son más largas y el jardín está en otro entangle
[The shadows are longer and the garden is in another tangle]
De color y textura y la temperatura ha bajado un poco
[Of colour and texture and the temperature has dropped a little]
El final de la tarde es cuando el día completo ha sido poco a poco
[Late afternoon is when the whole day has been sipped little by little]

[Chorus — English]
Late afternoon, late afternoon
The hour that the garden is most itself and most in tune
The birds are finishing their second shift and settling to the tune
Of the evening — and the day is nearly what it intended
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
Il tardo pomeriggio a Perth e la luce cambia angolo
[Late afternoon in Perth and the light changes its angle]
Le ombre sono più lunghe e il giardino ha un colore che si perde nell'angolo
[The shadows are longer and the garden has a colour lost in the corner]
Il profumo del rosmarino nel pomeriggio dorato
[The scent of rosemary in the golden afternoon]
È il profumo dello Zimbabwe e di Perth — due luoghi amati
[Is the scent of Zimbabwe and Perth — two beloved places]

[Outro — All three languages]
Late afternoon… El final de la tarde… Il tardo pomeriggio
The garden is most itself — El jardín es más sí mismo — Il giardino è più se stesso
The gardens still growing
